Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.scenemanager.utils.startmenu.data

Class StartMenuData

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.scenemanager.utils.startmenu.data.StartMenuData
public class StartMenuData extends Object
The main data structure for the start menu. This class maintains all the groups in the menu, as well as references to the current and default groups. It is also responsible for creating and maintaining links between groups, and ensuring the sanity and validity of the links.

      public void addGroup(MenuGroup group, boolean isDefaultGroup)
      Add a new group to the menu and possibly set it as the default group. Note: this group will be set as the default group if there is not already a default, regarless of the isDefaultGroup parameter.
